name: @brainfeather/mcp
description: Long-term memory for AI coding agents. Facts recorded once, recalled by every client.
author: Brainfeather
//files: Whitelist, not .npmignore: only these ship. Prevents src, tests and stray build artifacts reaching the registry.
//engines: Node 20.3 is the floor because request cancellation uses AbortSignal.any.

scripts.check: pnpm run test && pnpm exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm run build && pnpm run smoke:cli
scripts.//prepublishOnly: Rebuilds from a clean dist so a stale artifact from a deleted source file cannot ship.
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run clean && pnpm run check
